name.en: Emperor Yang of Sui opens the Tongji Canal

summary.zh: 隋炀帝开凿通济渠，连接洛阳与淮河。
summary.en: Emperor Yang of Sui opened the Tongji Canal, linking Luoyang with the Huai River.

description.zh: 605 年，隋炀帝下令开凿通济渠，自洛阳西苑引谷、洛水入黄河，再引黄河水入淮河。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 605, Emperor Yang of Sui ordered the Tongji Canal to be dug, linking Luoyang with the Yellow River and then the Huai River. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Opening the Yongji Canal

summary.zh: 隋炀帝开凿永济渠，北通涿郡。
summary.en: Emperor Yang of Sui opened the Yongji Canal northward to Zhuojun.

description.zh: 608 年，隋炀帝下令开凿永济渠，引沁水南达黄河，北通涿郡。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 608, Emperor Yang of Sui ordered the Yongji Canal to be dug, connecting the Yellow River with Zhuojun in the north. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Opening the Jiangnan Canal

summary.zh: 隋炀帝开凿江南河，连接京口与余杭。
summary.en: Emperor Yang of Sui opened the Jiangnan Canal between Jingkou and Yuhang.

description.zh: 610 年，隋炀帝下令开凿江南河，自京口至余杭，沟通长江与钱塘江。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 610, Emperor Yang of Sui ordered the Jiangnan Canal to be dug from Jingkou to Yuhang, linking the Yangtze and Qiantang rivers. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Sui-Tang Grand Canal takes shape

summary.zh: 通济渠、永济渠、江南河相继完成，隋唐大运河形成。
summary.en: The Tongji, Yongji, and Jiangnan canals were completed, forming the Sui-Tang Grand Canal.

description.zh: 611 年前后，通济渠、永济渠、江南河相继完成，以洛阳为中心的隋唐大运河形成。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: Around 611, the Tongji, Yongji, and Jiangnan canals were completed, forming the Sui-Tang Grand Canal centered on Luoyang. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Tang dynasty grain transport flourishes

summary.zh: 唐代以洛阳、长安为中心，漕运依赖运河。
summary.en: In the Tang dynasty, grain transport centered on Luoyang and Chang’an relied on the canal.

description.zh: 8 世纪前期，唐代漕运以洛阳、长安为中心，江淮粮米经运河转运关中。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the early eighth century, Tang grain transport centered on Luoyang and Chang’an, moving grain from the Jiang-Huai region to the Guanzhong plain via the canal. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Luoyang as the center of the Sui-Tang canal

summary.zh: 唐代洛阳仍是运河漕运中心。
summary.en: In the Tang dynasty, Luoyang remained the center of canal grain transport.

description.zh: 8 世纪，唐代洛阳仍是运河漕运中心，江淮粮米经汴河、黄河转运关中。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the eighth century, Luoyang remained the center of Tang canal grain transport, with grain from the Jiang-Huai region moved via the Bian and Yellow rivers to the Guanzhong plain. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Song dynasty grain transport on the Bian River

summary.zh: 北宋以开封为中心，汴河成为漕运主干。
summary.en: The Northern Song centered on Kaifeng, with the Bian River as the main grain transport artery.

description.zh: 北宋建立后，以开封为中心，汴河成为连接江淮与京师的漕运主干。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: After the Northern Song was founded, Kaifeng became the capital and the Bian River became the main grain transport artery linking the Jiang-Huai region with the capital. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Kaifeng and the Bian River towns

summary.zh: 北宋开封依赖汴河，沿线市镇繁荣。
summary.en: Northern Song Kaifeng relied on the Bian River, and towns along it flourished.

description.zh: 11 世纪，北宋开封依赖汴河漕运，沿线市镇繁荣。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the eleventh century, Northern Song Kaifeng relied on Bian River grain transport, and towns along the river flourished. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Hangzhou and Southern Song grain transport

summary.zh: 南宋临安依赖江南运河与浙东水系。
summary.en: Southern Song Lin’an relied on the Jiangnan Canal and the eastern Zhejiang waterways.

description.zh: 12 世纪，南宋临安（杭州）依赖江南运河与浙东水系维持漕运。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the twelfth century, Southern Song Lin’an (Hangzhou) relied on the Jiangnan Canal and eastern Zhejiang waterways for grain transport. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Yuan dynasty opens the Huitong Canal

summary.zh: 元代开凿会通河，打通山东段运河。
summary.en: The Yuan dynasty opened the Huitong Canal through Shandong.

description.zh: 1289 年，元代开凿会通河，自济宁至临清，打通山东段运河。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1289, the Yuan dynasty opened the Huitong Canal from Jining to Linqing, connecting the Shandong section of the canal. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Yuan dynasty opens the Tonghui Canal

summary.zh: 元代开凿通惠河，连接大都与通州。
summary.en: The Yuan dynasty opened the Tonghui Canal, linking Dadu with Tongzhou.

description.zh: 1293 年，元代开凿通惠河，连接大都与通州，使运河船只可直达都城。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1293, the Yuan dynasty opened the Tonghui Canal, linking Dadu with Tongzhou so that canal boats could reach the capital. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal is completed

summary.zh: 会通河、通惠河与旧有运河连接，京杭大运河全线贯通。
summary.en: With the Huitong and Tonghui canals linked to older waterways, the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal was completed.

description.zh: 1293 年，会通河、通惠河与旧有运河连接，北京至杭州的京杭大运河全线贯通。日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1293, the Huitong and Tonghui canals were linked with older waterways, completing the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal. Dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Jining as the Huitong Canal hub

summary.zh: 济宁成为会通河与泗水水系交汇的枢纽。
summary.en: Jining became the hub where the Huitong Canal met the Si River system.

description.zh: 14 世纪初，济宁成为会通河与泗水水系交汇的枢纽，是山东段运河的重要码头。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the early fourteenth century, Jining became the hub where the Huitong Canal met the Si River system and an important wharf on the Shandong section. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Tianjin as the junction of sea and canal transport

summary.zh: 元代天津成为海漕与运河交汇点。
summary.en: In the Yuan dynasty, Tianjin became the junction of sea and canal transport.

description.zh: 14 世纪初，元代天津成为海漕与运河交汇点，南北粮运在此转运。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the early fourteenth century, Tianjin became the junction of Yuan sea and canal transport, where north-south grain shipments were transshipped. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Ming dynasty grain transport system

summary.zh: 明代确立以运河为主的漕运制度。
summary.en: The Ming dynasty established a grain transport system centered on the canal.

description.zh: 15 世纪初，明代确立以运河为主的漕运制度，每年转运数百万石粮米至北京。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the early fifteenth century, the Ming dynasty established a grain transport system centered on the canal, moving millions of shi of grain to Beijing each year. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Dezhou granary

summary.zh: 明代德州设仓，转运漕粮。
summary.en: In the Ming dynasty, Dezhou had a granary for transshipping grain.

description.zh: 15 世纪中期，明代德州设仓，转运漕粮，是运河山东段的重要仓场。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the mid-fifteenth century, Ming Dezhou had a granary for transshipping grain and was an important storage site on the Shandong section. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Huai’an grain transport governor

summary.zh: 明代淮安设漕运总督，统管运河漕运。
summary.en: In the Ming dynasty, the grain transport governor was stationed at Huai’an.

description.zh: 15 世纪中期，明代淮安设漕运总督，统管运河漕运与河道。日期与制度为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the mid-fifteenth century, the Ming grain transport governor was stationed at Huai’an, overseeing canal grain transport and waterways. Dates and institutions follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Linqing customs house

summary.zh: 明代临清设钞关，成为运河税关重镇。
summary.en: In the Ming dynasty, Linqing had a customs house and became a key canal tax town.

description.zh: 15 世纪中期，明代临清设钞关，成为运河税关重镇与南北货物集散地。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the mid-fifteenth century, Ming Linqing had a customs house and became a key canal tax town and entrepôt for north-south goods. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Tongzhou granary

summary.zh: 明代通州设仓，漕粮由此入京。
summary.en: In the Ming dynasty, Tongzhou had granaries where grain entered the capital.

description.zh: 15 世纪中期，明代通州设仓，漕粮经通惠河由此入京。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the mid-fifteenth century, Ming Tongzhou had granaries, and grain entered the capital via the Tonghui Canal. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Zhenjiang as the canal’s Yangtze entrance

summary.zh: 镇江是江南运河入长江口，南北转运要冲。
summary.en: Zhenjiang was the Jiangnan Canal’s entrance to the Yangtze and a key transshipment point.

description.zh: 15 世纪中期，镇江是江南运河入长江口，南北粮运在此转运。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the mid-fifteenth century, Zhenjiang was the Jiangnan Canal’s entrance to the Yangtze and a key transshipment point for north-south grain. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Qing dynasty grain transport at its height

summary.zh: 清代前期漕运达到鼎盛，运河沿线市镇繁荣。
summary.en: In the early and mid-Qing, grain transport reached its height and canal towns flourished.

description.zh: 18 世纪中期，清代漕运达到鼎盛，运河沿线市镇繁荣。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the mid-eighteenth century, Qing grain transport reached its height and towns along the canal flourished. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Suzhou’s silk and rice markets

summary.zh: 清代苏州丝米市繁荣，依赖江南运河。
summary.en: In the Qing dynasty, Suzhou’s silk and rice markets flourished, relying on the Jiangnan Canal.

description.zh: 18 世纪中期，清代苏州丝米市繁荣，依赖江南运河与周边水网。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the mid-eighteenth century, Suzhou’s silk and rice markets flourished, relying on the Jiangnan Canal and surrounding waterways. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Yangzhou and salt transport

summary.zh: 清代扬州盐运与运河漕运相互支撑。
summary.en: In the Qing dynasty, Yangzhou’s salt trade and canal grain transport supported each other.

description.zh: 18 世纪中期，清代扬州盐运与运河漕运相互支撑，扬州成为运河沿线重要商业城市。日期与规模为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In the mid-eighteenth century, Yangzhou’s salt trade and canal grain transport supported each other, making Yangzhou an important commercial city along the canal. Dates and scale follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The Yellow River changes course and damages the canal

summary.zh: 黄河在铜瓦厢改道，冲断运河，漕运受阻。
summary.en: The Yellow River changed course at Tongwaxiang, breaking the canal and disrupting grain transport.

description.zh: 1855 年，黄河在河南兰考铜瓦厢改道，冲断运河，山东段漕运受到严重影响。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1855, the Yellow River changed course at Tongwaxiang in Lankao, Henan, breaking the canal and severely disrupting grain transport in Shandong. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The grain transport system ends

summary.zh: 清末漕运停止，运河失去主要功能。
summary.en: In the late Qing, grain transport ended and the canal lost its main function.

description.zh: 1901 年，清廷下令停止漕运，运河失去主要功能。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In 1901, the Qing court ordered grain transport to stop, and the canal lost its main function. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.note: 运河开凿时间参考，路线为示意简化

name.en: The canal declines in modern times

summary.zh: 漕运停止后，运河失修，部分河段淤塞。
summary.en: After grain transport ended, the canal fell into disrepair and some sections silted up.

description.zh: 1901 年以后，漕运停止，运河失修，部分河段淤塞，沿线市镇衰落。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: After 1901, with grain transport ended, the canal fell into disrepair, some sections silted up, and canal towns declined. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.
